main_text.head: BENIGNO LECTORI.
main_text.p: IRENICI hujus major pars αὐτοχεδιασὶ delineata, & festinantibus operis, ad prælum ilicò rapta est. Unde factum, ut postea relegenti occurrerint nonnulla quæ clarioris explicationis indigere existimavi. Quocirca quæ impræsentiarum inserenda vel etiam mutanda videbantur, ea satius duxi in istis pagellis tibi candidè exhibere, quam mea mihi animadversa παραφάσματα aliis vel sequenda vel reprehendenda relinquere. Te interea, benigne Lector, amanter rogo, ut hanc ingenui animi opellam boni consulas. Nihil enim in toto hoc negotio ago καθ' ἑτερομέρησιν: sed veritati & paci, coram DEO, studiosè deservio: & quæ vera judico, ea sine fuco, χωρὶς οἰασδήποτε προσαπαθείας ἢ ἀντιπαθείας, enuncio. Divina igitur misericordia fiducia in spem bonam optati successus animus erigitur.
main_text.head: Soli DEO Gloria.

page.notes: The opening "I" is a large initial, read as I plus "RENICI". The word after "delineata," is printed as "festinantibus" but the scan is smudged; the reading is doubtful. The Greek words, especially "αὐτοχεδιασὶ", "καθ' ἑτερομέρησιν" and "προσαπαθείας", may differ slightly from the print. The top and bottom ornamental borders are decorative and not transcribed.
